source.author: verg
source.text: Tum vero ancipiti mentem formidine pressus obstipui, steteruntque comae et vox faucibus haesit.
source.text_original: Tum vero ancipiti mentem formidine pressus / obstipui, steteruntque comae et vox faucibus haesit.
source.text_english: Then indeed, my mind was crushed by doubly fearful dread; I stood stunned, and my hair stood on end and my voice stuck in my throat.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: haesit uox faucibus et inter ruborem atque pallorem metumque ac laetitiam cogitationes uariae mutabantur.
reuse.text_original: haesit uox faucibus et inter ruborem atque pallorem metumque ac laetitiam cogitationes uariae mutabantur.
reuse.text_english: His voice stuck in his throat, and between blush and pallor, fear and joy, his thoughts kept changing.
